pages.title: Mixed Structures
pages.text: For a $(l)structure$() print, the machine doesn't refuse the whole job over a few bad blocks. It $(l)skips$() any block it can't print (too high a tier, or un-priced) and builds everything else.$(br2)Only an $(l)item$() print, or a structure where $(l)nothing$() is printable, shows Not Printable outright.
